notes.title: We tried something new, and it rhymes!
notes.notes: [p]We made a card game! Well... not a TCG-kind of card game, but one where card combinations result in darkly humorous microstories. [/p][p]If you like stories, rhymes, and mischievous fairies toying with mortal fates - wishlist [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2804100/Fates_Theater/"]Fate's Theater[/url] and check its demo during this Steam Next Fest! [/p][p][i][u]Warning:[/u] The game contains 0% platforming, 50% fairies and 50% dark humor.[/i][/p][p]Thanks for your attention 💜[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2804100/Fates_Theater/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

Our next (bigger) game is Out Now! Take a look:

Thank you all for your support over these past five years.

notes.title: We are Eva annoncement
notes.notes:
Hi.

It's been 4 years since E.Z was released ([i]Woah![/i]). I'm glad that such a small game was able to find its niche. But today I would like to announce something else I am proud of.

It is called We are Eva - the dimension-traveling platformer, which is the next chapter of my personal growth as a developer, and ([i]hopefully[/i]) will be a breath of fresh air in the platforming genre.

If E.Z is something you enjoyed playing, I am pretty sure you'll like We are Eva. The game is participating in this year's Steam Fest ([i]which is going on right now[/i]), with its own demo you could try. So check it out, play the demo, and have fun!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1490590/

[i]With love to games,
Totally Normal Creature[/i]

notes.title: IJWTHF
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31931057/9544f5e46f686fcf57a942cd54b286f462efb40f.png[/img]
[i]
Can't finish the game? Suffering too much? The game keeps throwing you back to the level you hate? Here comes IJWTHF!

Don't Mind its name, because what matters is that it will make your life just alot easier (I mean... it wont pay your taxes for you or anything like that but...)

Anyway.
[/i]

[b]IJWTHF[/b] or [b]"I Just Want To Have Fun"[/b] is the new gamemode that lets you play the game without being thrown back on deaths (not even once.. yay ☺).

Yes, you now can play E.Z without worry of death cheating you, just have fun or learn how the levels work in general.

Of course, to make it fair, you'll not be added to the leaderboard and most of the achievements will be locked. However, there is one special achievement to be earned which only can be done by playing IJWTHF.

Have Fun!
